data.one_liner: A mock Supabase client for unit testing API calls without network requests.
data.what_it_does: Intercepts HTTP requests for Supabase clients and stores mock data in memory. Supports select, insert, update, upsert, delete, filtering, ordering, limiting, edge functions, and RPC calls.
use_when: You need to unit test Supabase API calls in your Flutter or Dart app
You want to mock Supabase tables, edge functions, and RPC calls without real network connections
avoid_when: You need full support for auth, realtime, or storage mocks
You need nested referenced table data or !inner joins
strengths: Allows testing database operations and filtering easily in memory
Supports custom edge function handlers and mock RPC functions
Provides error trigger callbacks to simulate postgrest exceptions
weaknesses: Discontinued in favor of supabase_test once supabase_flutter v3 is released
Does not support nested referenced table data or table schemas
Does not support auth, realtime, or storage
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and pass the mock HTTP client to your SupabaseClient.
